changeinfo.changes:
• Added new netcode options
  • Host's language now shows on Multiplayer Search Results
  • New selection menu for Rankings
  • Added "Top" and "Me" to Rankings view
  • Now makes a sound when someone joins your hosted room
  • Fix scroll wrapping in Controls Menu
  • Support touch screen
  • Cosmetic UI fixes
  • Fix rare issues when sync'ing online stats

• Improved network error/state messaging
  • Text improvements
  • Local game play now in Japanese if system language is Japanese
  • Improve input lag for local and online play
  • Fix potential desync when DEMO CUT options didn't match between Host and Guest

• Fix menu problem if you tried to back out of error message when there's not enough space to save your profile data.
  • Will now prompt before deleting damaged save data.
  • Improved error messaging.
  • Fix problem where game could get stuck if you tried to start an online match before cross-save completed.
  • Remove black screen after attempting to go online with an underage account.
  • Fix typo in Tizoc's move list.
  • Adjusted font for legibility.
  • Fixed problems transitioning between ad hoc and online matches.
  • Fixed electronic manual.
